summary: ING Groep N.V. filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of an ad hoc home-country disclosure) attaching a press release dated November 3, 2026, reporting weekly progress under its €1.65 billion share buyback programme announced October 29, 2026. During the week of October 29 through October 30, 2026, ING repurchased 1,050,000 shares at an average price of €28.57, for total consideration of €30,000,765.00. Cumulative repurchases under the programme total 1,050,000 shares at that average price, approximately 1.82% of the maximum programme value. The programme's stated purpose is to reduce share capital; no board recommendation, adviser, regulatory clock or ownership-split mechanics are disclosed. Watch execution pace against the €1.65 billion authorization and any updates to the buyback cadence.
